notes: Refers to the cooler part of the afternoon from around 3:00 PM until sunset (around 6:00 PM). Used in the greeting 'Selamat sore' (Good afternoon / early evening).
Do not confuse with 'siang' (around 11:00 AM to 3:00 PM) or 'malam' (night/evening after sunset).
